name: RapAI
tagline: AI rap video maker: photos in, two-person 9:16 rap out.
description: RapAI (airapvideo.design) is a browser-based AI rap video maker that turns one or two photos into a short two-person rap performance with generated vocals — no camera, editing, or crew. Pick a theme or paste your own lyrics; export 9:16 for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Clips are 4–15 seconds. Lip-sync accuracy varies. There is no audio or song upload. Paid only: no free plan, free trial, or free signup credits. One-time packs Lite $6.90 (390 credits) / Pro $14.90 (1,000) / Ultra $29.90 (2,200); credits valid 365 days; failed videos refunded; no subscription. No commercial-use license is offered yet.
